annotation.authors_or_issuer: Cabinet of Japan / Artificial Intelligence Strategic Headquarters (Cabinet Office)
key_provisions_or_claims: Emphasises vertical AI and physical AI as Japan's winning strategy for AI Transformation (AX).
Promotes 'Responsible Agile Governance' to address technical, social and national security risks of agentic AI.
Seeks AI sovereignty and strategic autonomy across compute, data, models and semiconductors.
Four pillars: accelerating deployment, strengthening development, leading AI governance, building an AI-powered society.
Plan reviewed and revised annually via the AI Strategic Headquarters and Expert Panel on AI Strategy.
annotation.summary_en: Japan's Second AI Basic Plan, adopted by Cabinet under the AI Promotion Act (provisional translation, July 2026). It prioritises vertical and physical AI for AI Transformation, AI sovereignty, and agile responsible governance of agentic AI risks, setting measures on deployment, development, governance and society, with annual revision.
annotation.title_clean: Japan's Second Artificial Intelligence Basic Plan — Japan AI Transformation; A Stronger Nation. Greater Prosperity.
